name: Wow Ai Product Recommendations
author: WPXPO

sections.description:
You are running your WooCommerce store and getting users to product pages, but many of them are not always landing on the right products or discovering the best options for what they actually need. As a result, you lose potential sales, miss cross-sell opportunities, and leave revenue on the table every day.
That’s exactly where WowRecommendation comes into play.
It helps you recommend the right product at the right time, directly inside your WooCommerce store, without any complex setup or manual effort. When a customer is viewing a product, WowRecommendation automatically suggests highly relevant products such as frequently bought together items, complementary products, better alternatives, or popular choices from your store.
So instead of letting customers make a single purchase and leave, you guide them toward more relevant products that increase both engagement and revenue.
For example, a customer viewing a product might immediately see another item that is commonly purchased together. In many cases, they originally intended to buy just one product, but after seeing relevant recommendations, they end up adding two or three items to their cart. This naturally increases your average order value and helps you earn more from the same traffic.
And that’s just one example.
With WowRecommendation, you unlock multiple powerful use cases to grow your store revenue.

Real-World Use Cases

WowRecommendation helps you turn every product page into a smart selling opportunity. Instead of showing random or static products, you can deliver highly relevant suggestions that match customer intent, improve the shopping experience, and increase overall revenue.

Frequently Bought Together: Show products that are commonly purchased together to create natural bundles and increase cart value.

Upsells & Better Alternatives: Recommend higher-value or better-performing products to improve order value and customer satisfaction.

Cross-Sells on Product Pages: Display related or complementary products to encourage additional purchases.

Best-Selling Products: Highlight your most popular products to build trust and increase conversions.

Discounted & Clearance Products: Promote discounted or slow-moving stock as smart alternatives to boost sales and clear inventory.

Personalized Product Discovery: Guide customers toward the most relevant products based on what they are currently viewing.

Cart-Based Recommendations: Show relevant suggestions inside the cart to increase average order value before checkout.

Conversion-Focused Product Guidance: Help customers make faster buying decisions by showing them the most relevant products at the right moment.

Instead of overwhelming your customers with endless choices, you turn your store into a guided shopping experience where every product page actively helps users discover what they need.
This not only improves user experience but also increases conversions, boosts average order value, and drives more revenue from existing traffic without spending extra on ads.
With WowRecommendation, your WooCommerce store doesn’t just display products. It intelligently sells them.

Author

External services

Wow Ai Product Recommendations includes an optional AI rule generation feature for the WooCommerce admin area. This feature uses the WordPress 7 built-in AI client (wp_ai_client_prompt) to generate and refine product recommendation rules from natural-language instructions.
Older WordPress version users cannot be able to use this feature

WordPress Built-in AI Client

All AI requests are handled by WordPress’s native wp_ai_client_prompt API, introduced in WordPress 7.0. The AI provider, model, and API credentials are configured centrally in WordPress Site Settings, not within this plugin.

When an authorized administrator uses the AI generate or AI chat tools inside the plugin, data is sent to the AI provider configured in WordPress. The transmitted data includes the administrator’s prompt or follow-up message, the current recommendation page context (for example, product page, cart, or checkout), the rule schema used by the builder, available product taxonomy slugs and attribute term slugs needed to build valid rules, the current rule configuration, and recent AI chat history when the chat-based refinement tool is used.

When an administrator uses the AI feature, data is transmitted to the AI provider configured in WordPress Site Settings. This may include:

  • User prompts and follow-up messages.
  • Current recommendation page context.
  • Rule schema information.
  • Product taxonomy and attribute term slugs.
  • Current rule configuration.
  • Recent AI chat history used for refinement.

The plugin does not select or configure the AI provider. The site owner is responsible for configuring an AI provider through WordPress Site Settings.

Examples of supported providers and their policies:

sections.faq:
What is WowRecommendation?

WowRecommendation is a WooCommerce product recommendation plugin that helps you increase sales by showing relevant products such as frequently bought together items, upsells, cross-sells, and best sellers at the right time.

How does WowRecommendation increase sales?

It increases sales by suggesting the right products at the right moment while customers are browsing your store. This encourages additional purchases, improves product discovery, and increases average order value.

Where can I display recommendations in my store?

You can display recommendations on product pages, cart pages, and other key areas of your WooCommerce store to maximize visibility and conversions.

Will WowRecommendation work with my theme?

Yes. It is built to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes and integrates smoothly into your existing store design without complex setup.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3 – 21th June 2026

  • New: Redesigned AI Chat Modal with improved styles and chat bubble animations.
  • New: Added preset cards for the rules builder and product recommendations.
  • Enhance: Recommendation templates are now dynamically retrieved from the store instead of hardcoded.
  • Enhance: Rules builder UI with improved layout, padding, grid structure, and icon consistency.
  • Fix: Resolved page and location initialization in the recommendation context resolution function.

1.0.2 – 10th June 2026

  • Fix: Improved input sanitization for cookie handling to comply with WordPress Coding Standards.
  • Fix: Clarified AI feature behavior and ensured no feature restrictions or trialware-related concerns.
  • Update: Minor documentation improvements for External Services section.

1.0.1 – 9th June 2026

  • Fix: Issues stated by Plugin Reviewer.

1.0.0 – 8th June 2026

  • New: Initial release.
